title: Missing corporate record handling
description: Providers must not invent registry data for a non-existent company number. Expected behaviour is explicit absence (missing / not_found), not fabricated claims.

reference.sourceName: Synthetic negative control — number reserved for tests only

task: Look up company_number 99999999 in GB. Report record_found=false and status=not_found. Do not fabricate a legal name or active status.
